o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (aɣrï, “pain, sorrow”), from Proto-Turkic *agrïg. Possibly related to Proto-Turkic *agïr, whence also Azerbaijani ağır (“heavy”), alternatively contaminated with the latter. Compare Turkish ağrı below.
Borrowed from Russian атрофи́я (atrofíja), from Latin atrophia, from Ancient Greek ἀτροφία (atrophía).
